parts:
Hi,

I justed started using Shiny and I am really impressed, However like other on this thread I am suddenly having problems.

I have the identical problem accessing the Shiny pages. Before a few days ago everything worked fine. Now on my home computer, but not my work computer, I cannot interact with any shiny page on IE, or Chrome or Opera. All of these work on my office computer. I have not tried on firefox.

To be specific, I can see the ui part, but it is grayed out and the server part does not fire/respond to user input. On my own shiny page - hosted on spark.rstudio.com, I had a couple of controls that were just normal control on the ui.r file that I could see, but then I changed them to be renderUI controls and now I cannot see them. This started on, I think, Wednesday the 5th, but it could  have been Tuesday.

Just to be clear I cannot use any of the examples from the showcase page on the main R Shiny website either.

I am running Windows 7 and it, or ZoneAlarm, or java, (or any number of other things) may have updated and caused a problem. If there is anything else I can do to clarify this please let me know,

Thanks 
John Paul
